title: VendPoint Substitute Settling Pars and Ordered Supply to the Ship-To
content:
A Corbett-placed substitute that also reaches the machine's ship-to on order lines of its Ship-To Fulfillment Account has its settling par on the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine sized at an order share.

The order channel factor follows the units of the substitute shipped on order lines to the machine's ship-to in the three months ending today: when those units are above zero and at least the selection's units, the factor is the heavy order share; when they are above zero and below the selection's units, the factor is the light order share; otherwise the factor is one.

The heavy order share is 0.75; the light order share is 0.9.

The selection's units are the units of the substitute and of the retired item vended from the machine in the three months ending today, less the units of either returned to the machine or credited for a vend error in the same three months, each record counted by its date.

Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

**Examples (hypothetical, selection's units 20).** 25 substitute units shipped to the ship-to: at least 20, share 0.75. 20 shipped: at least 20, share 0.75. 19 shipped: below 20, share 0.9. None shipped: 1.
